answers.question: Is multi-factor authentication required for employees?
answers.answer: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.

answers.question: Is customer data encrypted at rest?
answers.answer: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.

answers.question: Is data encrypted in transit?
answers.answer: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.

answers.question: Are backups taken and how long are they kept?
answers.answer: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.

answers.question: Do you perform penetration testing?
answers.answer: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.

answers.question: Do you scan for vulnerabilities and how fast are they fixed?
answers.answer: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.

answers.question: How quickly is access removed when someone leaves?
answers.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.

answers.question: How often is the disaster recovery plan tested?
answers.answer: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.

policies.name: access-control-policy.md
policies.text:
# Access Control Policy

## 4.1 Accounts

Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.

## 4.2 Authentication

All workforce members must authenticate with a second factor. SMS is not an accepted factor.

## 4.3 Leavers

Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.

answers.question: Do code changes require review before they are merged?
answers.answer: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.

answers.question: Is two-factor sign-in required on your source code platform?
answers.answer: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.

answers.question: Do you scan source code for committed secrets?
answers.answer: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).

answers.question: Is the cloud root account protected with multi-factor authentication?
answers.answer: Yes. The root user of our production AWS account (111122223333) has multi-factor authentication.

answers.question: What is the password policy for cloud console users?
answers.answer: IAM users in our AWS account (111122223333) must use passwords of at least 14 characters, and passwords expire after 90 days.

answers.question: Is public access to object storage blocked?
answers.answer: Yes. Our AWS account (111122223333) blocks all public access to S3 buckets account-wide.

answers.question: Are cloud disks encrypted by default?
answers.answer: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.
